show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/kafWwD
show.description: A self-made billionaire returns to Kochi, his homeland to marry the woman he secretly built into a business icon—only to be humiliated and rejected by her. Hiding his true identity as the elusive “Shadow Tycoon,” he enters a contract marriage with a fierce heiress, turning heartbreak into a high-stakes game of power and revenge. But as love, betrayal, and ambition collide, the lines between fake and real begin to blur—and the ultimate price of betrayal is yet to be paid.
